items.title: The lower shriek functors along the three projections of the standard triangle are inverse to the pullbacks

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: with the notation of the three-maps equation, Lg_{i,!} composed with g_i^{-1} is the identity for i = 1, 2, 3, and hence Lpi_! composed with g_i^{-1} equals Lpi_{i,!} for each i (source lines 1506-1512). The proof is a case analysis driven by fibred category structures: for i = 1 it exhibits C_{C/B/A} as fibred over C_{B/A} with fibre category C_{C/P}, applies the fibred-category computation of left derived lower shriek and uses that the restrictions are constant; for i = 2 the analogous fibred structure over C_{C/A} is used together with the existence of final objects in the fibres; for i = 3 the computation lemma for the lower shriek is applied to u_3 with the sheaf g_3^{-1}F, whose values are identified as a pullback along a morphism of topoi, so that the polynomial algebra lemma gives the vanishing of the higher homology groups.
